g.text: Gates, questioners and auditors all still fire.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #57606a

g.text: Only the second opinion goes away.

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #57606a

g.text: Two models disagreeing is the useful signal. Two models agreeing is cheap — they share most of their training data,

text.style: font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'Noto Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #57606a

g.text: so Propel reports consensus as weak evidence rather than as confirmation.
